title: Heavy-weight content
slide_intent: Teach designers to offer several entry points into a long publication. A reader may need the headline, summary, quotation or detail at different stages.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give long reports the urgency of its campaign work while retaining enough structure for extended reading.
demonstration: A report cover with a portrait and boxed headline appears beside an annotated editorial spread. Leaders identify headings, standfirst, body copy, quote, captions, pullout and footnotes.
practical_value: Build a report hierarchy from cover headline through standfirst, paragraph and notes, then check which elements a reader can scan before reading in depth.

content_islands.name: Report-cover example
content_islands.spec: Place the portrait cover at lower left and label its principal type roles with leaders outside the image.

content_islands.name: Interior spread
content_islands.spec: Give the annotated interior example the larger right area. Contrast the main title and text column with image, quotation and colored callout panels.

content_islands.name: Type-role annotations
content_islands.spec: Align the named settings around the examples and use fine blue leaders to connect each note to its specimen.
